transcript: Yeah, I've seen this a million times on MACH-A. When the humidity gets really high, like over 80%, and you start hearing that vibration picking up... the bearings are about to go. You gotta replace the bearing immediately.
It's weird, but I swear these machines always break down on Tuesdays. Failures definitely increase every Tuesday. You should just do preventative maintenance on Monday nights.
For the main motor, if it starts running hot and the belt looks frayed, that's a motor failure waiting to happen. Usually means the alignment is off.
